name: Legendary V10
intro: Ten cylinders, sky-high redlines and a scream you feel in your chest. These are the V10s that defined an era of supercars and race cars, tuned here to rev cleanly from a lumpy idle to a howling top end.

name: Exotic V12
intro: Twelve cylinders firing in perfect balance: smooth at idle, operatic at full throttle. The V12 is the sound of grand tourers and hypercars, and every one in this collection has its own character as the revs climb.

name: Supercharged Monsters
intro: Big displacement, forced induction and a supercharger whine on top of a thunderous exhaust. These engines make power everywhere, and their sound builds like a wave from the first touch of the throttle.

name: Legendary V8
intro: From cross-plane muscle burble to flat-plane race-car shriek, the V8 has more voices than any other layout. This collection covers the icons, each with its own idle rumble and its own way of reaching the redline.

name: JDM and Turbo Legends
intro: Rotaries, inline-sixes and high-revving fours from Japan's golden age of performance. These are the engines of tuner culture, touge runs and time attack, from buzzing rotary idles to turbocharged pulls.

name: European Cult Classics
intro: Inline-fives, flat-sixes and characterful V6s from Europe's most loved performance cars. Each one has a sound enthusiasts recognise instantly, from rally-bred warble to racing-derived wail.

name: Signature Sounds
intro: SuperRev's own engine characters, from a deep diesel six to a screaming eleven-thousand-rpm ten. Built from the ground up for the app, they cover every layout and mood, and the first ones are free to rev.
